meta.title: Daniel Heinze — Software Developer
meta.description: Daniel Heinze, a software developer from Poland. Works on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux and builds OnSide, a platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.

hero.title: I build software that businesses
hero.lead: Hi, I'm Daniel, a PHP developer from Poland. By day I work on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux, a malware scanning API for WordPress and PHP plugins. After hours I build OnSide, a platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.
hero.terminalLabel: Terminal: Daniel Heinze, Software Developer. Works on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux and on OnSide.

cloudlinux.title: Now at CloudLinux
cloudlinux.lead: CloudLinux builds CloudLinux OS and Imunify360 for web hosting companies. Their products run on more than 600,000 servers. I joined in September 2025 and work on Imunify Connect.
cloudlinux.text: An API and PHP library that lets WordPress and PHP security plugins offer Imunify's malware detection and cleanup under their own brand. It scans files by their hash and, since the latest release, the WordPress database as well.

work.title: Selected work
work.subtitle: My own product and client projects

onside.title: OnSide
onside.text: Everything a Pro Clubs league needs, in one place: sign-up, teams, automatic fixtures, results checked against the EA API, public leagues, stats, rankings and achievements.

partio.title: Partio
partio.text: Fast product import and search across millions of records, plus file uploads for the team.

grupapwc.title: Grupa PWC
grupapwc.text: One panel for staff and machines: hours worked, meetings and holidays.

scanbot.title: Scanbot for Filament
scanbot.text: A custom Filament component built on the Scanbot SDK. Users scan and manage documents straight from the admin panel, with document detection, OCR and barcode scanning.

fivio.title: Fivio
fivio.text: Shows suppliers which products are in demand and runs an auction for the best offer.

webratings.title: Webratings
webratings.text: An admin panel and REST API for product data on air purifiers, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, air conditioners and vacuums. Editors manage specs, fields and labels, and the API serves the data.

about.title: About
body: Five years of PHP, most of them in web hosting: first WHMCS modules at ModulesGarden, now security products at CloudLinux.
I also build Laravel apps for clients and my own platform, OnSide. I like simple, reliable code and admin panels that are quick to work in.

cloudlinux.text: Imunify Connect: a malware scanning API and PHP library for WordPress and PHP plugin developers.
